capabilities: Look up kcal and macro values for ingredient lines via USDA FoodData Central
Append heading-section totals and a final total line to the note
Preview matched USDA foods with confidence values before rewriting the note
Map ingredient aliases to preferred USDA search terms
Configure delimiter, macro display, and low-confidence review markers
extras: The API key is free from USDA; the plugin states it sends search queries and the key to the USDA API but has no telemetry. Setup requires building from source with npm and copying files into the vault, so it is not a simple one-click install.
problem: Obsidian has no nutrition lookup, so writing food-log notes means manually computing and typing calorie values for each ingredient.

relations.evidence: looks up matching foods through USDA FoodData Central, appends kcal values

summary: Annotates ingredient lines in the active note with kcal values from USDA FoodData Central and appends underlined section and total lines.
